## [2.4.0](https://github.com/amfakh/fakh-patches/compare/v2.3.2...v2.4.0) (2026-11-21)

### New Features

* **Confluence:** add support for `5.26.1.1` with Material You, Pitch black, Glass navigation bar and Disable Play license check ([021436f](https://github.com/amfakh/fakh-patches/commit/021436f9c556a193c7ff75386718b1ce9455efd3))

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks Pro and removes ads. Also keeps the trial from expiring and the license check from closing the app.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Disable data collection SDKs
patches.description: Turns off the location, Wi-Fi and network data SDKs.

patches.name: Faster startup
patches.description: Skips the splash screen's wait of up to 5 seconds.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+), with rounder corners and more spacing.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium (no ads, music equalizer) and keeps the ad networks from starting.

patches.name: Song info in media notification
patches.description: Shows the song title and album art in the media notification, instead of the station name.

patches.name: Disable Play license check
patches.description: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill, and the Create button above it as glass.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+) in light and dark mode.

patches.name: Pitch black
patches.description: Turns the dark mode backgrounds black.

patches.name: Disable Play license check
patches.description: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Liquid Glass blurs what's behind it.

patches.name: Hide Rovo button
patches.description: Removes the floating Rovo Chat button, the Rovo icon in the issue header and the Rovo "Answers" block in search.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+) in light and dark mode.

patches.name: Dark device panels
patches.description: Darkens device control panels that have no dark mode of their own while the phone is in dark mode, using Android's automatic dark theme. It stays off until its switch in Settings is turned on.

patches.name: Glass cards
patches.description: Draws the cards on the Home tab as glass in the app's own colors, and gives the weather card a glass edge over its weather background.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill, in the app's own colors. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide App Mall
patches.description: Removes the "App Mall" row from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide Mall tab
patches.description: Removes the Mall tab from the navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide Me banner
patches.description: Removes the promo banner ("Enjoy Your Smart Life") and the ad slot from the Me tab.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Lets the patched app start. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the app's integrity check rejects, so without this it closes a few seconds after it opens.

patches.name: Swipe between tabs
patches.description: Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar. Where Scene shows Automation and Tap-to-Run as tabs, it switches between them first.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the ad banners, native ads, sticky ads and full-screen ads, and the ads on cnnindonesia.com pages opened in the app.

patches.name: Merge article pages
patches.description: Shows every page of a multi-page article in one continuous article, without the page numbers.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium (every locked feature, no trial limit) and stops the Play license check from closing the app.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Fix song playback
patches.description: Lets songs play in the patched app, instead of hanging on "loading".

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so your collection and playlists saved to your Google account come back. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes ads. Also keeps the license check from closing the app.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes banner, feed, video and full-screen ads.

patches.name: Stop autoplay
patches.description: Stops the videos in the "Video Pilihan" block under an article from playing on their own. They play when tapped.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: A floating, translucent navigation bar. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. The switch is in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Landscape navigation bar position
patches.description: Adds a setting in Fakh Patches that moves the landscape navigation bar to the left or right edge.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+), with an AMOLED black option. The switches are in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds settings in Fakh Patches that hide the labels of the navigation bar tabs and choose which tabs it shows.

patches.name: Allow Developer options
patches.description: Lets short movies play while Developer options are turned on, instead of asking to turn them off.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off analytics and tracking.

patches.name: Fix server error after idle
patches.description: Logs in again when the session has expired, instead of showing "kesalahan server".

patches.name: Hide Create button
patches.description: Removes the "+" button (write news, start a live stream) from the middle of the navigation bar. The switch is in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the Google ad banners from the home, article, quiz, event and live screens, and the promo popups.

patches.name: Hide home tabs
patches.description: Adds switches to hide the Nonton, IDN Live, Berita and Quiz tabs in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Hide package banner
patches.description: Removes the "Beli Paket" banner from the profile, since packages cannot be bought in a patched app. The switch is in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Redirect Gold purchase
patches.description: Opens connect.idn.media/my-account/gold in the browser instead of the in-app Gold top up.

patches.name: Stop autoplay
patches.description: Adds a switch to stop the video previews and the automatic sliding of the home banners in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Always show navigation bar
patches.description: Adds an option in Fakh Patches to keep the navigation bar on screen while you scroll.

patches.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches.description: Lets you view profiles without showing up in "Who viewed your profile". Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Copy text
patches.description: Adds Copy text to the ⋯ menu of posts and comments. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Dark app icon
patches.description: Black app icon with the white "in". Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops most LinkedIn analytics events from being sent. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches.name: Disable screenshot share sheet
patches.description: Stops the Share sheet from opening when you take a screenshot of a post. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds download buttons to profile photos and banners and Download media to the ⋯ menu of posts. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Expand posts
patches.description: Adds an option in Fakh Patches (off by default) to show posts expanded by default. Tapping the text collapses them.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds feed filters to Fakh Patches, such as celebrations, job posts and video posts. All off by default.

patches.name: Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Adds a Background blur switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the profile menu.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide gaps and dividers
patches.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches.name: Hide top bar buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Post and Messaging buttons of the top bar. In Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors across the app (Android 12+).

patches.name: Material icons in the navigation bar
patches.description: Material icons for the navigation bar tabs. Adds a switch in Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches.name: More tab
patches.description: Lets you hide items of the More tab (Puzzle games, Groups, Events, Newsletters), or list them at the bottom of the profile menu.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Lets you choose the navigation bar tabs, including Post, Video, News and Messaging, and hide its count badges and labels. In Fakh Patches.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Opens outside links without LinkedIn's warning page.

patches.name: Pitch black
patches.description: Black backgrounds in dark mode.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

patches.name: Swipe between tabs
patches.description: Swipe sideways to switch tabs of the navigation bar.

patches.name: Tap to hide controls in viewers
